card.architecture: Qwen-Image-Edit 20B base + merged 4-step distillation + NSFW LoRAs (all-in-one, fp8)
card.summary: Uncensored, distilled all-in-one editor on the same 20B Qwen-Image-Edit base. 4-step (~30s), bundles encoder+VAE. Use for NSFW or when safety-aligned editors silently decline.
card.pick_when: Uncensored / NSFW editing, or when other editors silently decline; also the fastest editor.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction; distilled, CFG 1.
prompt.overview: Community all-in-one merge built on Qwen-Image-Edit 2511; it has no edit-phrasing rules of its own, so phrase edits using Qwen-Image-Edit conventions. Distilled: run at CFG 1, 4-8 steps.
prompt.instructions:
This is a distilled all-in-one merge (accelerators + VAE + CLIP) whose latest build is 100% Qwen-Image-Edit 2511. Run settings: CFG 1, 4 steps (up to 8) -- the base model's true_cfg 4.0 / 40-50-step settings do NOT apply. SFW and NSFW variants exist. Only prompt tip the source gives: adding 'Professional digital photography' helps reduce the plastic look.
For instruction phrasing, follow the base Qwen-Image-Edit conventions: plain natural-language add/remove/change instructions (EN or ZH); choose semantic vs appearance phrasing; add disambiguating context; quote exact text for text edits and correct iteratively; describe layout for multi-image; mention identity preservation when needed. At CFG 1, negative prompts have little or no effect.
do: Pick the SFW or NSFW variant for your use
Optionally add 'Professional digital photography' to cut the plastic look
Phrase edits using base Qwen-Image-Edit conventions
dont: Apply the base model's high-CFG / 40-50-step settings
Rely on negative prompts at CFG 1
Expect AIO-specific edit-phrasing rules (there are none)
examples: Change the rabbit's color to purple, with a flash light background.
prompt.negative_guidance: At CFG 1 a negative prompt has little or no effect; the merge gives no negative guidance.

ui_help.note: Uncensored editor; edits an existing image from an instruction.

edit_use_cases: UNCENSORED instruction image editing; use for NSFW or when safety-aligned editors decline; fastest editor (distilled 4-step)

reference.hint: Your photo is image 1; your attached references are image 2 and image 3. Refer to them by number. Example: 'put the dress from image 2 on the person in image 1.'
